risks.risk: Machine may not stitch properly (timing/belt/gear/bobbin issues) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: Video of the machine sewing a straight line on fabric (with needle threaded and bobbin inserted) showing consistent stitches.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven/assumed to need servicing (worst case for second-hand).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (needles, bobbin, presser feet, thread tension parts) or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included parts laid out: needles, bobbins, presser feet, bobbin case, power plug, and any manuals.

risks.risk: Electrical/pedal fault or weak power (pedal responsiveness, cable damage).
risks.proof: Short video showing pedal press response (needle movement) and a close-up of the power cable/plug condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may have electrical issues (worst case).

risks.risk: Needle/bobbin area wear or damage (rust, bent needle bar, worn feed dogs) affecting durability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of needle area, feed dogs, and bobbin compartment (both sides if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/aged condition (worst case based on visible wear).

proof_requests: Send a short video of it sewing (straight stitch) with fabric, showing needle movement and consistent stitch formation.
Send close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, and bobbin compartment.
Show all included accessories (needles, bobbins, presser feet, bobbin case) laid out clearly.
Show the power plug/cable condition and a clip of pedal response (needle moving when pressed).
response.reason: The brand “IDEAL TOPSTAR” is readable from the photo, but key value drivers (whether it sews correctly, completeness of parts, and electrical/pedal health) are not verifiable from a single wide shot. To price safely for Lagos pickup, we need proof it stitches and what accessories are included.
